headline: The Sindh government has formed a joint investigation team led by DIG Irfan Baloch, with ISI, IB, Rangers and NCCIA representatives, to probe the murder of a 25-year-old Karachi businessman after a judicial commission ruled his death a murder, not suicide.

card.desc: Commission ruled it murder; police conduct under review.

caption:
The Sindh government has formed a joint investigation team under DIG Irfan Baloch, with ISI, IB, Rangers and NCCIA representatives, to probe the murder of a 25-year-old Karachi businessman, Arab News reports. A judicial commission ruled his death a murder, not suicide, and a one-member committee will review the conduct of 13 police officials named in its report, Express Tribune adds.
